description: Defines the HttpCache::Writers class and its nested TransactionInfo struct, managing synchronized network and cache transactions for HTTP caching in Chromium.

classes.name: HttpCache::Writers
classes.description: Manages multiple HTTP cache transactions sharing network and cache resources, ensuring synchronized access and data integrity.

classes.name: HttpCache::Writers::TransactionInfo
classes.description: Stores per-transaction information such as partial data, truncation status, and response info.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves data from the network transaction, possibly synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: StopCaching
methods.description: Stops caching if no other transactions are active.

methods.name: AddTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction to the writers set with initial writing pattern, priority, and info.

methods.name: RemoveTransaction
methods.description: Removes a transaction from the writers set.

methods.name: UpdatePriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of transactions based on current state.

methods.name: SetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Associates a network transaction with the writers.

methods.name: ResetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Resets the network transaction, used for range requests.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the network transaction.

methods.name: CloseConnectionOnDestruction
methods.description: Closes network connection when the object is destroyed.
